fields: (a spec block, as skid-sheet): h, caption (eyebrow and a title block cell), intro, rows [{p, v, m, link, link_label, part}], note, cols[2] (the basis button's word). part (look-only): membranes, utilities, exchanger, edi, piping, joints, frame, pump, drain, panel. A row without a part lists with no tag. Every row shows on every width.
best_for: OrthoSheet reads a skid's design parameters off an orthographic general-arrangement sheet: one RO and EDI skid drawn flat in two views, the front elevation over the plan, with a numbered tag on a leader from each part to the parameter it governs and the parameter rows beside the sheet under the same numbers.
